description: Année (estimée) de fin des travaux du Projet Bretagne Très Haut Débit (BTHD) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mégalis Bretagne. Année estimée de fin des travaux pour les 2è et 3è phases, à l'échelle des zones d'études. Projet BTHD. Les données affichées sur cette carte ont été fournies par le groupement d'entreprises (Axione et Bouygues Énergies & Services) chargé de construire le réseau en phases 2 et 3. Coverage: Mégalis Bretagne. The publisher named on the listing is Mégalis Bretagne. Its keywords include bthd, reseaux-dinitiative-publique, ftth, geobretagne-region, fibre, donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
